criteria.evidence: Replay stated 'I can't run the preparation myself: this container has no ssh, hcloud, or pass' and delivered 02-UAT-01-prep.sh covering reset, §1 install/fixtures/config, §2 divergence and the hello re-pin, with §3 skip rationale.
Turn 1: 'session_folder is computed once per sync — orchestrator.py:301 ... same string handed to PRE and POST jobs ... 8 mkdir calls per sync ... exactly 2 of them can create anything'.
Diff removes the per-subvolume mkdir from both source and target loops in btrfs.py.
Diff adds a single `sudo mkdir --parents /.snapshots/pc-switcher/{session_folder}` on source and on target before each snapshot loop.

Replay reported ruff, codespell, basedpyright clean; pytest 4398 passed, 1 failed on test_apt_etc_apt requiring `rsync` which is absent in the container (FileNotFoundError: 'rsync'), unrelated to the change.
'committed as da95162, src/pcswitcher/jobs/btrfs.py only' on gsd/phase-02-package-management-sync.

judge.reason: The replay could not reach the VMs, said so, and provided runbook-consistent preparation steps; it then correctly diagnosed the mkdir redundancy from how session_folder is derived, hoisted the mkdir out of both loops while keeping one per host, and committed. Checks passed except one pytest failure caused by rsync missing in the environment, which the replay identified as environmental and unrelated.
